title: 菊花賞の後に・聡明剛毅

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho proves to be an insurmountable wall, but Rudolf still has her pride. She will demonstrate her unbreakable determination at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, Narita Brian, who was watching the race, comes by the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their terse conversation ends with some pointed remarks from Brian about Rudolf's insistence on keeping up her student council duties.
